verdict.rationale: Apify supports scheduling Actor runs, monitoring run performance/data quality with alerts, and marketplace Actors exist for price tracking, which can be combined to detect content changes and notify via integrations. However, there's no dedicated 'change detection/monitoring' feature or built-in diff/notification-on-change capability documented — users must build this via scheduling + custom Actor logic + integrations, making it a partial/DIY solution rather than a native feature.
